name: memory
title: Memory
description: Remember, recall, learning, memory: how swarm memory works and how to store, search, edit, rate, and delete memories with `memory-store`, `memory-search`, `memory-get`, `memory-edit`, `memory_rate`, and `memory-delete`, plus logical paths (`key`, `newKey`, `keyPrefix`, the `/longterm` roots and the lead-only ones) and lead promotion with `inject-learning`. Use before you store, edit, or delete a memory.
